notes: Connected OSM course candidate. The selected loop is the longest simple source-node cycle after explicit exclusions; its association with a named circuit configuration requires review.
Source way order and shared node IDs are retained. No nearby endpoints are joined and no reference boundaries are read.
Some source ways lack one-way direction tags. Travel direction is provisional.

Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 77 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Estimated paired road limits from the pinned licensed satellite image at approximately 0.73 m ground pixel spacing. The retained main route uses the tighter ninety-degree first-corner branch, distinct from the sweeping first-corner layout saved separately at this venue. Limits follow visible paint/curb transitions, excluding green shoulders, gravel traps, service lanes and fences. The two corresponding edges interpolate linearly between sparse paired observations; both their driving order and road-crossing direction are checked against the retained source. The outer limit through the shared-pavement first-corner opening (stations 1140–1176) is a fitted virtual join rather than a surveyed curb or continuous pavement boundary. Bridge and gantry shadows interpolate between adjoining observations. Original trace, timing and raster terrain remain unchanged. Pixel spacing is not positional accuracy; rendered curbs remain illustrative and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed from complete pairs of sparse image-edge measurements. Each pair defines its own road section; the original trace is preserved and constrains station displacement and route order. Linear intervals, junction openings and curbs remain estimates, not surveyed racing limits. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. No automatic evidence scores are claimed.
